opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage BUSD as a matrix-based opportunity where entry and higher-level purchases are connected to earning more money. Viewers are told they can put "$5 in X3" to obtain a working position tied to marketing activity, while the speaker states that opening larger levels will produce "a lot of money." The displayed Forsage materials reinforce that structure by showing upgrade prompts requiring 640 BUSD and 211 BUSD for different matrix positions. Taken together, these features promote participation in a recruitment- and tier-dependent earning scheme, rather than merely discussing how such a scheme operates.

citations.quote: So, plan of X3 means that you put $5 in X3, you got a chair, you got a working point, you got a place where you can work and do marketing in one hour.
Similarly, if you want a lot of money in the forces, you need to open big levels. When you open big levels, you will get a lot of money.
